title: MLRescurix Operational Budgets Configuration
description: Defines the three configurable operational budgets governing autonomous agent resource consumption. Generous defaults are provided. To change any budget, edit the corresponding 'limit' field.

total_model_tokens.description: Total model token usage counting prompt (input) and completion (output) tokens across all agents and model calls. Default: 5,000,000 tokens.

kaggle_compute.description: Total Kaggle GPU/TPU compute usage measured in hours as provided by the available Kaggle account environment (standard weekly free GPU allocation: 30.0 hours).

web_search_queries.description: Total web search query requests permitted across all autonomous research actions. Default: 500 queries.

spending_cap_preservation.description: Preserves dollar-denominated model spending cap and ledger history ($0.28049 campaign ceiling, $0.16015 remaining balance) in accordance with campaign governance rules.
